verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS compliance platform like ComplyAdvantage Mesh, but nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'monitor and unmonitor customers' endpoints control AML ongoing monitoring of screened customers, not product telemetry. The webhook-signing opt-in is an unrelated security setting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
